title: The Wrecker's Underwriter
logline: A predatory reinsurance broker contracts raiders to bleed freight convoys across three systems, engineering an artificial insurance panic to monopolize regional shipping lanes.

roles.description: A charming, ruthless maritime risk broker whose private reinsurance cartel profits from rising route instability.
Commands an independent merchant convoy battered by coordinated strikes across the regional gate network.
A fast commerce raider equipped with military-grade jamming suites and falsified hull markings.
A heavily guarded corporate station housing the regional shipping registry and policy clearinghouse.
A contested orbital gate chokepoint between systems where stranded convoys wait for escorts.
A mercenary strike wing secretly bankrolled by false-flag maritime security retainers.
A loose alliance of independent free-traders unable to afford extortionate insurance premiums.

public_situation: Freight insurance rates surge across three systems as coordinated commerce raiders target independent convoys approaching regional jump gates.
private_truth: {role:syndicate_underwriter} finances the raiders through off-world escrow accounts to force unaligned merchants into usurious reinsurance cartels.

beats.public_change: Underwriting kiosks announce a thirty percent war-risk surcharge on all unescorted gate transits.

missions.reason: The commodore needs a deep-space sensor sweep of an intercepted raider wreck to trace how the corsairs acquired encrypted merchant convoy schedules.
missions.private_fact: The commodore suspects his own logistics purser was bribed with debt forgiveness to leak departure timetables.

beats.public_change: Raiders blockade {role:border_jump_gate}, stranding dozens of loaded freighters in open vacuum.

missions.reason: The commodore hires the pilot to eliminate corsair skirmishers trapping merchant freighters outside the border gate.
missions.private_fact: The commodore is out of maneuvering fuel and cannot afford another forty-eight hours of gate demurrage fines.

missions.reason: Recover the destroyed corsair commander's encrypted navigational core before solar drift wipes the volatile memory banks.
missions.private_fact: The core contains direct financial authorizations stamped with corporate seals from the underwriting citadel.

beats.public_change: {role:syndicate_underwriter} issues a public proclamation offering total debt immunity to any pilot who surrenders recovered flight data.

missions.reason: The underwriter attempts to buy off the pilot, offering triple rates to courier the recovered nav core directly to his private station suite.
missions.private_fact: The underwriter has already drafted execution warrants for the pilot should they dock without delivering the encryption key.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds documented evidence that the regional pirate crisis was manufactured by the underwriting syndicate.

options.label: Deliver the corsair nav logs to the merchant league tribunal to crush the underwriter's syndicate
Blackmail the underwriter for a permanent silent partnership in the regional reinsurance monopoly

beats.public_change: The underwriter dispatches his personal heavy corsair to ambush the commodore's flagship outside the judicial station.

missions.reason: The commodore contracts the pilot to destroy the underwriter's assassin cruiser before it can wipe out the tribunal witness ship.
missions.private_fact: The corsair captain hails mid-battle offering an entire cargo bay of bearer platinum if the pilot disengages and allows the target to jump.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the assassin cruiser and presents proof to the league.
resolutions.summary: {role:syndicate_underwriter} is arrested for treason and false-flag piracy; {role:merchant_league} reclaims free navigation across regional lanes.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed a syndicate underwriter who hired pirates to corner regional transit insurance.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot blackmails the underwriter for a share of the reinsurance syndicate.
resolutions.summary: The evidence is buried and the pilot takes a quiet share of transit premiums; independent merchants face crushing fees across three systems.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the raider captain's bribe and lets them jump.
resolutions.summary: The corsair escapes with syndicate gold while {role:syndicate_underwriter} flees system jurisdiction; {role:convoy_commodore} survives but routes remain dangerous.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the core to the underwriter for immunity.
resolutions.summary: The underwriter destroys the nav core and establishes a total reinsurance monopoly; {role:merchant_league} is forced into bankruptcy.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the missions or ignores the blockade.
resolutions.summary: Corsairs wipe out the merchant convoy at {role:border_jump_gate}; {role:syndicate_underwriter} buys out bankrupt shipping charters at pennies on the credit.

loose_threads.detail: The destroyed commerce raider carried premium waiver certificates signed by the citadel chief underwriter.
Underwriting dividend payments surge across three systems exactly forty-eight hours after each recorded raid.

radio_hooks: Reinsurance syndicates report record earnings amid ongoing trade route instability.
Independent merchant convoys in {system} demand naval escorts through contested jump gates.
Commerce raider attacks spike outside regional transit corridors as freight tariffs double.

voice_direction.syndicate_underwriter: Affable, cultured, speaking in silky financial euphemisms and brushing off violence as unfortunate market friction.
voice_direction.convoy_commodore: Gruff, gravelly, barking orders in weathered naval terminology and bitterly cursing corporate bureaucrats.
